ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms allowed ingress, a default action and the world-admin flag are declared; it does not read the live firewall.
offer: Allow only required ingress and retain a default-deny policy. Administrative network access must not be open to the world.

minimal.reason: List the ingress that is explicitly allowed. Anything unlisted should be closed, so name each port and source.

mid.reason: Declare the default action, which should be deny. An allow-by-default firewall exposes everything not listed, so state deny.

maximal.reason: Set world-open admin access to false. Administrative ports open to the internet are a standing breach, so restrict them to known sources.
